DeepSpace Aether 1404 4600KV 3000KV 4S Brushless Motor For 2.5-4inch Toothpick RC Drone

The DeepSpace Aether 1404 4600KV Motor is a high-performance brushless motor designed specifically for 2.5 to 4-inch toothpick-style FPV drones. Built for pilots who demand responsive power, low weight, and durable construction, this 4600KV 4S motor delivers explosive speed and excellent efficiency across a wide range of micro drone builds.

Optimized for 4S LiPo batteries, the DeepSpace Aether 1404 4600KV Motor features high-quality materials including a precision-machined bell, robust shaft, and smooth bearings for extended durability and flight stability. Whether you’re flying freestyle, racing through tight gates, or cruising long range, this motor provides the thrust and responsiveness needed for agile handling.

The compact 1404 stator size makes it a perfect fit for ultralight builds, and its versatile mounting pattern ensures wide compatibility with popular frames.

description.plain:
The RATEFPV 1404 Brushless Motor series (4600KV/3800KV/2900KV) delivers tailored, reliable performance validated by global pilot reviews. Engineered for lightweight 2.5-4 inch builds—ideal for sub-250g setups compliant with most US/EU regulations—this motor balances power, efficiency, and durability, solving common pain points of budget alternatives (overheating, inconsistent thrust, poor responsiveness). With three optimized KV options, it caters to aggressive racing, smooth freestyle, and long-range filming, making it versatile for hobbyists and seasoned pilots alike. Its premium construction (including smooth bearings and precise winding) ensures consistent performance, while its lightweight design (around 9.5g) enhances agility without sacrificing sturdiness

Features 

1. Three KV Options (Tested & Pilot-Approved)

4600KV: 4S 2.5-3 inch freestyle/racing—max power for aggressive flying; Betaflight throttle expo fine-tunes control.

3800KV: 4S 2.5-3 inch cinewhoops/freestyle—smooth thrust, low current draw for steady footage.

2900KV: 4S 4-inch long-range/6S 2.5-3 inch racing—versatile, handles high loads without overheating.

2. Premium Durability & Consistency

High-quality components and strict QC avoid budget motor pitfalls. Crash-resistant uni-bell design and smooth bearings lower repair costs.

3. User-Friendly Design

Works with 4S/6S batteries, 2.5-4 inch frames; 9.5g design meets sub-250g regulations. High ESC compatibility simplifies setup.

4. Smooth Control for All Pilots

Linear power eliminates lag. 3800KV is beginner-friendly; 4600KV/2900KV are for pros chasing aggressive response.

Specifications

KV: 2900KV/3800KV/4600KV

Max Power: 169.57W(4600KV/D51-5)

Max Current: 10.60A(4600KV/D51-5) 

Slot Pole：9n/12p 

Winding：Single-strand Winding

Recommended Prop： 2-4 Inch (ø5 fixed holes） 

Dimensions： ø19.4mm x 17.5mm 

Output Shaft Diameter： ø1.5mm 

Output Shaft Length： 3.6mm 

Mounting hole： 9*9mm 

Input Voltage: 7.2v-17.4v 

FPV Drone Recommended Voltage: 10.8v-17.4v(3-4S Lipo/Hv) 

Lead Wires：100mm/24AWG

ESC: ＞ 15A 

Weight: 10.19g( include the wire)

description.plain:
Unmatched performance for sub-250g 2.5-3” Cinewhoops and Freestyle quads.

What do you do when you’ve broken the world drone speed record with a motor capable of 580 kph? You bring that technology to the most popular drone category in the world: Sub-250g!

If you are seeking the ultimate performance for your sub-250g build, this is it. Built on the world-drone-speed-record-breaking technology of the AOS Supernova 3220, the AOS Supernova 1404 is engineered to deliver more torque, more power, and a more exciting flying experience than any 1404 before it.

The motor is optimized for driving 2.5” Bullnose or 3” Freestyle Tri-blade props on 4S battery voltage. On the thrust test stand and in the air, Chris Rosser found the Supernova 1404 outperforms any other 1404 motor he’s tested on the market, producing more thrust and a faster response without sacrificing efficiency. The Supernova 1404 broaches no compromises, delivering the smoothest footage on a Cinewhoop and also blowing away the competition in dynamic freestyle flying.

Built on the incredible success of the AOS Supernova 2207, 2807, and 3220 the 1404 takes the same revolutionary design philosophy and scales it down for the challenging demands of sub-250g drone pilots. Thanks to thousands of finite element simulations, including 4D field modeling for the first time, the Supernova 1404 delivers an exhilarating combination of control, power, and efficiency, all in service of the ultimate in-flight performance.

Exceptional designs require exceptional execution. That’s why the AOS Supernova 1404 is manufactured by RCinPower, a brand synonymous with race-winning and record-breaking motors. This partnership, coupled with AOS’s cutting-edge design approach, ensures that this motor not only meets but exceeds the expectations of the most demanding pilots. With the Supernova 1404, you can experience more than ever before, and still stay under 250g.

For smooth, precise low-throttle control and breathtaking top-end power, AOS recommends applying throttle expo in Betaflight. Start with Throttle MID = 0 and Throttle EXPO = 0.20, adjusting EXPO to fine-tune your desired throttle response. Increase EXPO for greater precision at low throttle or reduce it for a sharper, more aggressive feel.
